main.summary: Read-only stream wrapper that replays a single prefixed byte before continuing reads from an inner stream.

remarks.para: The logical stream exposed by this wrapper is: Prefix + Inner[InnerOrigin..].

When the inner stream supports seeking, this wrapper preserves seek, length, and position semantics for the logical combined stream by translating wrapper-relative offsets into inner-stream offsets beyond the replay prefix byte.
The wrapper does not support writing and does not own the lifetime of the inner stream.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Initializes a new replaying decryption stream.
constructor.param: Inner stream to continue reading after the prefixed byte has been replayed.
Single prefixed byte to replay before reading from the inner stream.

remarks.para: If the inner stream supports seeking, its current position is captured as InnerOrigin and used as the start of the logical inner segment.

field.name: Inner
field.summary: Inner stream that supplies bytes after the prefixed byte has been consumed.

field.name: InnerOrigin
field.summary: Starting position of the inner stream when the wrapper is created.

remarks.para: All seek, length, and position calculations are measured relative to this captured origin rather than absolute position zero of the inner stream.

field.name: Prefix
field.summary: Single prefixed byte replayed before reads flow through to the inner stream.

field.name: PrefixOffset
field.summary: Current replay-state offset for the prefixed byte.

remarks.para: This value is zero before the prefix byte has been exposed and one after it has been consumed.
It forms the prefix portion of the wrapper Position calculation.

property.name: CanRead
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the stream supports reading.

remarks.para: This value is delegated directly from the inner stream.

property.name: CanSeek
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the stream supports seeking.

remarks.para: This value is delegated directly from the inner stream.
When false, Length, Position, and Seek are not supported.

property.name: CanWrite
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the stream supports writing.

remarks.para: This wrapper is read-only and always returns false.

property.name: Length
property.summary: Gets the logical length of the replay stream.

remarks.para: When supported, Length = 1 + ( Inner.Length - InnerOrigin ).
This is the total logical length of the one-byte replay prefix plus the readable suffix of the inner stream beginning at the captured origin.

property.name: Position
property.summary: Gets or sets the current logical position within the replay stream.

remarks.para: Getter: Position = PrefixOffset + ( Inner.Position - InnerOrigin ).

Setter: if the assigned value is zero or one, PrefixOffset is moved to that value and Inner.Position is reset to InnerOrigin; otherwise PrefixOffset is set to one and Inner.Position is set to InnerOrigin + ( value - 1 ).
The position is always relative to the logical combined stream, not the absolute coordinate space of the inner stream.
This is a no-op because the wrapper only replays a single byte and performs no writes.

method.name: Read
method.summary: Reads bytes into an array buffer.
method.param: Starting offset within the destination buffer.
Maximum number of bytes to read.

remarks.para: This overload validates arguments, projects the requested segment as a span, and delegates to the span-based read implementation.

method.name: ReadSpan
method.summary: Reads bytes into a span buffer.

remarks.para: The algorithm is: if the replay prefix byte has not yet been consumed and the destination buffer is non-empty, write Prefix to the first destination element, set PrefixOffset to one, then if buffer still has remaining capacity read the remainder from the inner stream.
The returned count is the sum of the replayed prefix byte, when present, and bytes read from Inner.

method.name: ReadAsync
method.summary: Reads bytes asynchronously into an array buffer.
method.param: Starting offset within the destination buffer.
Maximum number of bytes to read.

remarks.para: This overload validates arguments, projects the requested segment as memory, and delegates to the memory-based async read implementation.

method.name: ReadAsyncMemory
method.summary: Reads bytes asynchronously into a memory buffer.

remarks.para: The algorithm is identical to the synchronous span read: if the replay prefix byte has not yet been consumed and the destination buffer is non-empty, write Prefix to the first destination element, set PrefixOffset to one, then asynchronously read any remaining capacity from the inner stream.
The returned count is the sum of the replayed prefix byte, when present, and bytes read from Inner.

method.name: Seek
method.summary: Sets the logical position within the replay stream.

remarks.para: The target wrapper position is computed using the supplied origin against the logical combined stream.
SeekOrigin.Begin uses offset directly, SeekOrigin.Current uses Position + offset, and SeekOrigin.End uses Length + offset.
After target calculation, the Position setter performs translation into PrefixOffset and Inner.Position.

method.name: SetLength
method.summary: Sets the length of the stream.

remarks.para: This member is not supported because the wrapper is read-only and does not own the inner stream length.

method.name: Write
method.summary: Writes bytes from an array buffer.
method.param: Starting offset within the source buffer.

remarks.para: This member is not supported because the wrapper is read-only.

method.name: WriteSpan
method.summary: Writes bytes from a span buffer.

remarks.para: This member is not supported because the wrapper is read-only.

method.name: WriteAsync
method.summary: Writes bytes asynchronously from an array buffer.
method.param: Starting offset within the source buffer.

remarks.para: This member is not supported because the wrapper is read-only.

method.name: WriteAsyncMemory
method.summary: Writes bytes asynchronously from a memory buffer.

remarks.para: This member is not supported because the wrapper is read-only.
